additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426576-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/R4 312982230001] issue concerning Connector DC2 of the charging station CRM:02678000067
additional_info.body:
Hello,
As usual, I performed a hard reset on the devices and then set them to "available" status.
However, this type of issue is recurring — we experience it at least two to three times per week per charging station. These kinds of reports do not help us clearly identify or resolve the root cause of the malfunction on your Siemens Sicharge D charging stations.
You may proceed with a software update, but could you please confirm whether this will actually prevent the issue from happening again in the future?
Thank you in advance for your support.
Best regards,
